name: image-tools.scene-preparation-stage
purpose: Submit, reconcile or cancel a local scene-preparation stage, then assemble and review immutable photographic assets through their native owners.
assumptions: Input and mask refs identify artifacts already owned by Image Tools.
The caller pins an installed model and retains the exact inputs plus stable UUID before dispatch.
Native jobs own inference, cancellation, restart failure and results; this program does not introduce another queue.
A successful operation is mechanical evidence; a visual review is required before scene or film promotion.
PreparationService owns immutable bundles/review revisions; a prepared source is retained separately from disposable stage output blobs.
Device Studio conversion is an optional downstream stage; inference and preparation review remain usable when that scenario is unavailable.
invariants: One invocation makes at most one owner request, never polls or retries.
Local-only stages explicitly prohibit paid provider fallback and reclaim of other resources.
Lost admission responses are recovered using the same operation identity and source bytes, not a replacement job.
Changing source bytes or typed parameters requires a new stage identity and invalidates downstream preparation.
A cancellation acknowledgement does not prove that a running process has exited; observe or wait on the retained job.
Result references remain opaque owner references; the program never opens host paths or downloads models.
Source changes create a pending preparation; completed reviews are immutable child revisions and never mutate their parent.

signals.result_ref: Native owned output reference when available.
signals.review_required: Always true: inference success does not qualify visual quality.
signals.recovery: Exact original stage identity to reconcile uncertain admission.
signals.cancel_terminal: Whether cancellation readback is terminal, never a capacity-release claim.
signals.bundle_ref: Owned retained ZIP for Device Studio conversion.
signals.repair_assessment: Read-only actual removal-mask/context measurements; no quality acceptance.
signals.scene_revision: Exact Device Studio candidate revision; separate scene/motion review remains required.
signals.library_revision: Immutable asset publication under the declared edit and optional local-render source uses; visual qualification remains separate.

outputs.evidence: Native job ID and stable operation UUID; no image bodies.
